description: Research agenda for needs analyses supporting work-based learning interventions for vocational and technical education students.

requirements.purpose: Establish current/near-term employer demand relevant to the qualifications and territory.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Employer demand at county/regional level does not prove an individual student's skill deficit.

requirements.purpose: Describe labour-market participation/unemployment context for young people without substituting it for school-level evidence.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Youth unemployment context does not by itself prove the need for a specific intervention at one school.

requirements.purpose: Establish system-level evidence on vocational education relevance, work-based learning and school-employer links.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: System-level challenges cannot be presented as measured conditions at the beneficiary school.

requirements.purpose: Verify the actual beneficiary-school qualification offer and its fit to the intervention population.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Qualification authorization/offer does not prove practice quality, career intention or skill level.

requirements.purpose: Measure the beneficiary students' need for career information/guidance linked to their qualifications.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Perceived need for guidance is not an employment outcome.

requirements.purpose: Measure prior exposure to and perceived relevance of practice at economic operators.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Perceived practice quality cannot be presented as an objective technical competence test.

requirements.purpose: Create a school-level baseline relevant to practical readiness using an explicitly defined measurement method.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Self-assessed readiness must not be relabelled as objectively tested competence.

requirements.purpose: Measure students' stated intention to pursue work related to their qualification.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Stated career intention is not a certain prediction of later employment.

requirements.purpose: Provide territorial demographic context only where it materially affects the intervention logic.
requirements.prohibited_overclaim: Demographic decline is context, not automatically an empirical need of the target group.
